packages.name: mDash beta
packages.description: Control-first Hubitat dashboard: select your devices and you're done. Optimized for acting on devices — bulk room/house lights, multi-thermostat control. Installable PWA, built-in remote scheduler (no Hubitat login), runs entirely on your hub.

packages.name: mDash Shabbat and Holidays
packages.description: Optional Shabbat and Yom Tov schedules for Modern Dashboard. Installs mld-holiday.js. Leave this uninstalled unless you want that feature.

packages.name: mDash Synagogue
packages.description: Optional synagogue schedules for Modern Dashboard. Installs mld-synagogue.js. Leave this uninstalled unless you want that feature.
